decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range is the umbrella for several pharmacy products and gives the firm consumer-health diversification, so dropping the whole line soon is unlikely despite tough competition.
Skin and hair supplements are a crowded pharmacy segment, but the product sits cheaply within the existing range and likely earns enough to be kept.
Joint health is a steady demand category for older pharmacy customers and fits the firm's range, so it is likely retained.
Interest in immune-support products rose during the pandemic years, which makes this item one of the stronger candidates in the range.
The 2018 valsartan impurity recall hurt this product, but valsartan remains a high-volume generic that can be continued with a reliable ingredient supply, though margins are thin.
An over-the-counter triptan fits the firm's core pharmaceutical expertise and a niche with few competitors, so keeping it is clearly favoured.
